title: Account-Age Relief at Payoff — Home Comfort Financing
content:
**Account terms, payoff — relief by account age (Home Comfort Financing).** The payoff account-age relief is 10 percent when the account funded at least 36 whole months before the day of payoff, 5 percent when it funded at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months before, and zero when it funded fewer than 12 whole months before.

Account age is counted in whole months from the funded date to the day of payoff.

| Funded … before the day of payoff | Payoff account-age relief |
|---|---|
| 36 whole months or more | 10 percent |
| 12 to 35 whole months | 5 percent |
| fewer than 12 whole months | zero |

The payoff account-age relief is one of the payoff reliefs; the payoff reliefs are added together into the payoff relief percentage, and the starting rate is reduced once by that total, never one relief after another.

## Boundary pairs (hypothetical accounts)

- 11 whole months: zero. 12 whole months: 5 percent.
- 35 whole months: 5 percent. 36 whole months: 10 percent.

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

An account 40 whole months old takes 10 percent. Were that its only payoff relief, a starting rate of 9.99 percent would become 9.99 multiplied by 90 and divided by 100: 8.991 percent.
